The former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]] briefly [[Lightsaber duel|dueled]] with the [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitor]] known as the [[Second Sister]] after the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered him, but was rescued by the [[Stinger Mantis crew|crew]] of the ''[[Stinger Mantis]]''.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
